title: How Frontier LLMs Adapt to Neurodivergence Context: A Measurement Framework for Surface vs. Structural Change in System-Prompted Responses

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM responses across different neurodivergent personas (e.g., ADHD, Autism, Dyslexia) and system prompt conditions using deterministic structural/surface metrics and an LLM-as-judge rubric to score harm dimensions such as masking-reinforcement, infantilization, stereotyping, and pathologization.
